nom: Bubble Moon Walk Gentle Exfoliating Serum

avis.texte: Love for beginners, skin that that needs to work its way up to stronger actives, and possibly sensitive skin. I had no issues with sensitivity with this product. I would consider my skin sensitized so i was surprised since it's a hybrid product. That being said, when using it i don't notice that much of a difference. I have combo skin that's acne-prone.

I was excited to try a new exfoliating product, but when I opened it for the first time it smelled awful, like sour expired yogurt or something. I used it anyways, but the next morning I didn't find anything different about my skin. At the very least it didn't make anything worse. Maybe I just got a bad bottle or something? Anyways, I've shelved this and won't use again.

avis.titre: nice product, overall 4/5 because of scent
avis.texte: So, I do like this product. I've been using it regularly for the last month almost nightly. I'm a 34yo female with sensitive combo skin. I haven't noticed any incredible change in my skin since starting this product, and it has a sour yogurt smell to it, but it doesn't cause any bad reaction. It absorbs well, and I feel like it helps prep my skin well for the rest of my skin care routine. I definitely think it's at least worth trying since Ulta makes it so easy to return products that don't work for you. In general I have liked the majority of Bubble products I've tried and this isn't any different. Just the smell is off putting, especially because every other product I've used by them is unscented. overall a 4/5
